core: MECP2 control of neuronal gene expression
name: MECP2 neuronal gene control with translational and calcium-channel restraint
rationale: Most members are MECP2 regulatory events and Rett-type loss-of-function variants acting on neuronal genes; unlike C1/C4 the theme lacks the HDAC/NCoR and behavioural terms and instead carries repression of cytoplasmic translation and voltage-gated calcium channels.

name: NRF2 antioxidant response, redox homeostasis and ferroptosis control
rationale: Members are NFE2L2 regulation and target programmes, ROS detoxification, NADPH regeneration and ferroptosis control; this separates it from the hypoxia/HIF confusables (C1, C2, C4) and from the glutathione-transport confusable C3, which lacks the NFE2L2 terms.

name: Endogenous nucleoside and nucleobase transmembrane transport
rationale: All members describe plasma-membrane transport of purine/pyrimidine nucleosides and bases (adenine, adenosine, uridine); the closest confusable C2 adds antiviral drug (abacavir, ribavirin) handling, which this theme lacks.

name: ER tubular network shaping and membrane fusion
rationale: Members concern formation, regulation and fusion of the tubular endoplasmic reticulum and membrane curvature, whereas confusables centre on ER lipid transfer and phosphoinositide synthesis.

Members mix male germline terms (spermatogonial division, germ-line stem cell maintenance, Y-linked genes) with unrelated generic lncRNA transcription, mRNA nuclear export and histone crotonylation, so no single biological theme holds for all six.

name: NK cell cytotoxic activation and granzyme-mediated killing
rationale: All members concern NK (and related T cell) cytotoxic function and its targets, with positive regulation, anti-tumour killing and granzyme death distinguishing it from the inhibitory/KIR-tolerance confusables (C1, C3, C4) and the T cell activation confusable C2.

name: Cobalamin absorption, transport and metabolism with inherited defects
rationale: Every member is vitamin B12 uptake, transport, intracellular processing or a monogenic cobalamin disorder, unlike confusables covering other B vitamins (C1) or folate/methionine metabolism (C2-C4).

qualifier: via SHC adaptors in macrophage proliferation
name: CSF1R signaling via SHC adaptors in macrophage proliferation
rationale: Members are M-CSF/CSF1R (and IL-34) receptor signaling, its SHC adaptor branch and macrophage proliferation, distinct from G-CSF/granulocyte, IL-6, macrophage-differentiation and osteoclast confusables.

name: Prostanoid G protein-coupled receptors and prostaglandin D response
rationale: Members are prostanoid receptor and GPCR expression sets plus response to prostaglandin D, i.e. receptor-level signaling, whereas confusables cover leukotriene receptors or prostaglandin synthesis.

name: Nucleoside monophosphate breakdown and pyrimidine monophosphate salvage
rationale: Members concern turnover of ribo- and deoxyribonucleoside monophosphates (CMP, dCMP, dTMP, dGMP, UMP); CMP metabolism and UMP salvage distinguish it from the pyrimidine-catabolism (C1, C2) and purine-deoxynucleoside (C3, C4) confusables.

name: CSF1-driven monocyte, macrophage and osteoclast differentiation and fusion
rationale: Members are M-CSF signaling, monocyte/macrophage/DC and osteoclast differentiation, macrophage fusion and a CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte module; the fusion and monocyte-trafficking terms separate it from the interleukin/bone-remodelling confusables.

core: LXR transcriptional control of lipid metabolism
name: LXR transcriptional control of triglyceride and lipoprotein metabolism
rationale: Members are NR1H2/NR1H3 control of lipogenesis and adipose lipolysis plus restraint of VLDL remodelling, whereas confusables cover lipoprotein clearance, PKA-driven triglyceride catabolism or lipophagy without the nuclear receptor.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I/III transcription and splicing
name: Nuclear RNA polymerase I/III transcription, RNA processing and splicing
rationale: Members span Pol I/III transcription, rRNA/snRNA/tRNA processing and modification, spliceosome and 3'-end processing with MYC growth targets; this separates it from confusables on telomerase (C1), Pol II initiation/HIV (C2) and mRNA export/translation quality control (C4).

name: Cadherin adherens junction regulation in endothelial morphogenesis and EMT
rationale: Members concern cadherin-mediated cell-cell adhesion and adherens junction assembly, with endothelial morphogenesis and junction-organization regulation distinguishing it from the epithelial polarity and CDH1 trafficking confusables.

name: CCR7-associated dendritic cell maturation and leukocyte chemotaxis
rationale: Members cover CCR1/CCR7 chemokine signaling, DC maturation and survival, monocyte differentiation and T/NK cell migration control; DC maturation and CCR7 distinguish it from monocyte-recruitment (C1, C2) and lymphocyte-homing (C3, C4) confusables.

name: Microglial activation and amyloid-beta clearance in Alzheimer's pathology
rationale: Members combine microglial differentiation, activation and proliferation with amyloid-beta handling, tangle assembly and lysosome regulation; microglial terms separate it from C1/C4, and amyloid terms from C3.

name: TGF-beta and activin receptor cancer mutants and betaglycan regulation
rationale: Members are TGFBR/SMAD cancer mutants, TGFBR3 (betaglycan) control of TGF-beta/activin/FGF2, follistatin antagonism and AMH signaling; activin and betaglycan terms distinguish it from RUNX3/downregulation (C1), Hippo (C2) and canonical SMAD (C3) confusables.

name: Retinol and retinaldehyde metabolism and transport
rationale: Members are retinol/retinal and diterpenoid (retinoid) metabolism and transport, without the visual retinoid cycle defects of C1/C3/C4 or the retinoic-acid synthesis and response terms of C2.

name: Purine nucleoside transport and antiviral nucleoside analogue disposition
rationale: Members are purine nucleoside/nucleobase membrane transport plus abacavir and ribavirin handling, which separates it from the endogenous-only transport confusable C4 and the thiopurine/NUDT confusables C1/C3.

name: HDAC/NuRD corepressor chromatin regulation and cofactor SUMOylation
rationale: Members are histone deacetylase, NuRD/CHD, NCoR/SMRT and arginine methyltransferase chromatin events plus SUMOylation of chromatin and transcription cofactors, distinct from confusables on retroelement silencing, BAF complexes and histone acetylation/methylation.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor and CC chemokine production
name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven myeloid chemotaxis and CC chemokine production
rationale: Members are formyl peptide receptor signaling, neutrophil/granulocyte/macrophage chemotaxis and production of CCL5, MCP-1 and MIP-1alpha; the chemokine production and macrophage chemotaxis terms are absent from all confusables.

name: Mitotic chromosome cohesion, condensation, segregation and cytokinesis
rationale: Members span sister chromatid cohesion, chromosome condensation, CENP-A deposition, spindle function, cytokinesis and nuclear envelope reformation, unlike confusables on centrosome maturation (C1), NE disassembly (C2), APC/C (C3) and meiosis (C4).

name: Presynaptic calcium-triggered transmitter release and GABAergic modulation
rationale: Members concern presynaptic calcium, vesicle exocytosis, GABA secretion and short-term plasticity; GABA terms distinguish it from glutamate-release C1 and calcium-driven exocytosis from the G-protein inhibitory confusables C2-C4.

core: BMP and Nodal signaling in vascular development
qualifier: extracellular ligand regulation in endothelial differentiation
name: Extracellular BMP/Nodal regulation in endothelial differentiation and vasculogenesis
rationale: Members combine BMP/Nodal signaling and extracellular ligand sequestration with endothelial fate, arteriovenous and lymphatic differentiation; endothelial terms separate it from C1/C2 and extracellular ligand regulation from the cardiac-vascular confusables C3/C4.

name: MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis and RNA polymerase I regulation
rationale: Members are MYC target programmes with Pol I rRNA transcription control, nucleolar chromatin and ribosome assembly, a narrower growth-control core than confusables carrying full Pol I/III/II machinery, translation initiation or splicing.
